# Owner voice samples

Real posts written by the owner, supplied 2026-11-26. Used as:

- voice examples retrieved into generation prompts (loaded into `brand_knowledge` as
  `example_post` / `story` in Phase 1);
- `expected: pass` fixtures for the Phase 4 editorial evaluation suite.

They were not selected for engagement; they are representative of how the owner writes.
Edit nothing in these files: they are evidence of the real voice.

| file | kind | notes |
|---|---|---|
| post-001-hidden-losses.md | example_post | Five-scene list, reframe, "Today…" action |
| post-002-review-asking.md | example_post | Contrarian reframe: "not a reputation problem, an asking problem" |
| post-003-interview-story.md | story | Personal narrative. Its closing call to action ("open to … freelance projects") is off-positioning under Brand Guidelines v1.0; use for narrative voice only, never copy the CTA |
| post-004-boring-first.md | example_post | Everyday analogy (kitchen drawer vs garage), aphoristic close |
